mentions.name: @gooseus/natsrun
mentions.description: An npm library for routing messages within an application using the same wildcard subject semantics that NATS uses. It is intended for consuming a NATS firehose of messages in a single application and routing them internally with the same subject rules, making it easy to split them out as separate consumers later if needed.
